name: Sellbrite
description_en:
Sellbrite is a multi-channel listing, inventory and order tool for merchants selling through marketplaces and connected stores. It maintains product information, pushes availability and helps route or ship orders; it is not itself a marketplace audience or a replacement for every channel account.

The standard Sellbrite offer and Sellbrite for Shopify have separate pricing routes. This profile focuses on the standard product. Order volume, synchronization interval and optional FBA functionality are more useful selection variables than an unlimited-SKU headline.
description_zh:
Sellbrite 是面向市场及连接网店的多渠道刊登、库存和订单工具，用于维护商品、推送可售量及路由发货，并非自身提供市场流量，也不能替代各渠道账户。

标准 Sellbrite 与 Sellbrite for Shopify 分别有定价入口。本文介绍标准产品；订单量、同步周期及可选 FBA 功能，比“SKU 不限量”的标题更影响选型。

core_features.explanation_en: Publish and update listings on supported marketplaces and stores from product data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按商品数据在受支持市场及网店发布更新刊登。

core_features.explanation_en: View on-hand, reserved and available stock and choose warehouse sources per channel.
core_features.explanation_zh: 查看现有、预留及可用库存，并按渠道选择仓库来源。

core_features.explanation_en: Pricing counts connected-channel orders with a documented Amazon FBA exclusion.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按连接渠道订单计价，并有已说明的 Amazon FBA 排除项。

en: Use one SKU across two selling channels
zh: 让一个 SKU 对应两个销售渠道
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation scenario, not observed customer adoption.

pricing.billing_basis: Free 30-order tier and paid order-volume plans; annual/monthly cadence differs; FBA integration add-on and third-party channel/shipping fees separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free 30-order tier and paid order-volume plans; annual/monthly cadence differs; FBA integration add-on and third-party channel/shipping fees separate.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Use one SKU across two selling channels
sections.title_zh: 让一个 SKU 对应两个销售渠道
sections.en: A merchant could connect two supported channels, match the same physical SKU and set which warehouse stock is published to each. The inventory page distinguishes available, reserved and on-hand quantities. Test a sale on channel A and inspect channel B, then cancel and confirm reconciliation. Automatic sync is documented, but “avoid overselling” is not an absolute guarantee when two orders arrive before the next update.
sections.zh: 商家可连接两个受支持渠道，匹配同一实物 SKU，并设置各渠道发布哪些仓库库存。库存页区分可售、预留及现有数量。应在 A 渠道下单后检查 B 渠道，再取消并核对。文档说明自动同步，但两个订单在更新前同时到达时，“避免超卖”不是绝对保证。

sections.title_en: Read the sync interval alongside the free-plan limit
sections.title_zh: 同时核对同步周期及免费订单上限
sections.en: The pricing matrix lists inventory/price sync and order import every two hours on Free, versus every 15 minutes on paid Pro plans. The displayed Free allowance is 30 orders per month. A low monthly volume can still have bursts where a long update interval matters. Prepare channel permissions and stable SKU mapping; do not assume marketplace API restrictions disappear because Sellbrite is connected.
sections.zh: 定价表列出 Free 的库存价格同步及订单导入每 2 小时一次，付费 Pro 每 15 分钟一次；Free 额度为每月 30 单。月订单少也可能短时集中，更新周期仍重要。应准备渠道权限和稳定 SKU 映射，不能认为连接 Sellbrite 后市场 API 限制便消失。

sections.title_en: Count orders and FBA extras correctly
sections.title_zh: 正确计算订单及 FBA 附加项
sections.en: The retrieved annual-billing view lists Pro 100 at US$29/month, Pro 500 at US$79 and Pro 2K at US$179, with corresponding 100/500/2,000 monthly order limits. The FAQ excludes Amazon FBA orders from counts and describes automatic prorated tier upgrades when limits are exceeded. FBA Inventory & Multi-Channel Fulfillment is a separate US$19/month add-on. Payment, marketplace, postage and separate services such as ShipStation remain distinct expenses.
sections.zh: 读取的年付视图列出 Pro 100 每月 29 美元、Pro 500 为 79 美元、Pro 2K 为 179 美元，对应每月 100／500／2,000 单。FAQ 说明 Amazon FBA 订单不计数，超限自动升级并按剩余周期比例收费。FBA Inventory & Multi-Channel Fulfillment 另加每月 19 美元。支付、市场、邮资及 ShipStation 等独立服务仍是不同费用。

sections.title_zh: 按库存订单协调工具选型
sections.en: Sellbrite is relevant to merchants maintaining the same inventory across several channels. A seller who only needs a new standalone storefront or manufacturing planning has a different requirement. Start with a limited SKU set and an export, then test returns and split fulfilment. No live channel sync, postage purchase, account recovery, self-hosted distribution or open-source licence was verified. The 14-day broader trial is separate from the ongoing Free plan.
sections.zh: 在多个渠道维护同一库存的商家可评估 Sellbrite。只需新独立网店或制造计划的卖家需求不同。可先准备少量 SKU 及一次导出，再测试退货和拆单履约。本文未核实真实渠道同步、购买邮资、账户恢复、自托管包或开源许可；14 天扩展试用与持续 Free 套餐分开。

research_gaps.en: Selected billing amount, free-tier FBA edge cases, channel-specific throttling, exact reservation/cancellation timing and export/recovery commitments remain unverified.

research_gaps.en: No hands-on account, contract signing, integration, recovery or performance test was conducted; procurement terms and interface languages remain unverified.
